_readme: Phase 9 cohort definition. This file is BOTH the cohort's record and a usable
model registry: point the runner at it with --config config/phase9-cohort.json.
A model id here is the full "openrouter/<vendor>/<slug>" the CLI takes; the
exact-match entry supplies the endpoint, key variable and effort, so a run is
reasoningEffort is the rung this cohort pins. Effort is a confound on the order
of temperature: the same model at two rungs is a different experiment, so it is
recorded per model and quoted beside every score. The rungs differ per model and
two of these reason mandatorily, so there is no single cohort-wide constant.
The ladder each model actually lists lives in config/reasoning-efforts.json;
pre-flight refuses an effort the model does not list.
An ABSENT reasoningEffort (MiMo) means the parameter is omitted and the provider
default applies - it is NOT the same as "none", which is an explicit level.
The provider pin is passed on the command line, not from this file: every model
here is multi-endpoint on OpenRouter, so every run needs --only-provider
Rates live in config/openrouter-rates.json (dated); this file does not carry them.
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash is pinned to DeepInfra, not DeepSeek: the first-party endpoint is excluded by this account's privacy setting. Pass --only-provider DeepInfra for that row.
qwen/qwen3.8-27b replaced qwen/qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b by user decision before its run; same effort ladder (xhigh/medium/low), pinned to Alibaba at 0.425/2.55.
